sloka: इति ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणो अधः शिरा मुहुः ।श्रुत्वा मध्यम् जगाम इव मनसा दुह्ख हर्षयोह् ॥२-२३-१॥
transliteration: iti bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇo adhaḥ śirā muhuḥ ।śrutvā madhyam jagāma iva manasā duhkha harṣayoh ॥2-23-1॥

translations.english: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana listened to him with his head down, experiencing both grief and joy.
